metadata.source:
import doctest
import collections
suite = doctest.DocTestSuite(collections)
for case in suite:
    print(case.id())
    found = case._dt_test
    print(found.docstring)
    for example in found.examples:
        print(example.source)
        print(example.want)
        message = example.exc_msg
        if message is None:
            print("<no exception>")
        else:
            print(message)
        print(example.options)
        print(example.lineno)
        print(example.indent)
